newsitem.title: USA: MCI opposes SBC long-distance bid.
newsitem.headline: MCI opposes SBC long-distance bid.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp on Friday urged the Federal Communications Commission to reject an SBC Communications Inc bid to enter the long-distance telephone service market in Oklahoma.

SBC earlier Friday said its Southwestern Bell unit signed interconnection and resale agreements with 16 companies that want to provide local telephone service in Oklahoma. SBC said that qualifies it under the Telecommunications Act of 1996 to enter the long-distance market.
But MCI said new competitors seeking to enter the local service market in Oklahoma still face formidable barriers.

MCI said that prematurely giving SBC permission to enter the long-distance market in its traditional territory would remove its only major incentive to speed the opening of the market for local service.
